theorems.name: Submission.deformation_retraction_periodic_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (m ℓ : ℕ) (c₁ : ℝ) (a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∀ ψ₀ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ ψ₀ x i ∧ ψ₀ x i ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, ψ₀ x i = 0 ∨ ψ₀ x i = 1) → (∀ x x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → (∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, x' i - x i = k) → ∀ i, ψ₀ x' i - ψ₀ x i = x' i - x i) → (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ₀ x') (ψ₀ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x La + ε) * dist x' x) → ∃ ψ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x, x ∉ La → ∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, ∃ k : ℤ, ψ x i = k) ∧ (∀ (z : Fin (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℤ) (x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), x ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ ψ x i ∧ ψ x i ≤ z i + 1) ∧ ∀ (z : Fin (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℤ) (x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), x ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), x' ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ z i + 1) → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ x') (ψ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x La + ε) * dist x' x
